questions.q: In which year did Bahrain become independent from Britain?
questions.why: National Day is 16 December.

questions.q: Which family rules Bahrain?
questions.why: They have ruled since 1783.

questions.q: Which ancient civilisation was centred on Bahrain?
questions.why: It was a trading hub between Mesopotamia and the Indus.

questions.q: Before oil, what was Bahrain famous for?
questions.why: Its pearling path is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: In which year was oil discovered in Bahrain?
questions.why: It was the first discovery on the Arab side of the Gulf.

questions.q: Who has been King of Bahrain since 2002?
questions.why: He was Emir from 1999.

questions.q: What did Bahrain change from an emirate to in 2002?
questions.why: The ruler took the title King.

questions.q: Which ancient fort is Bahrain's first UNESCO site?
questions.why: It was the capital of Dilmun.

questions.q: Which burial mounds number in the tens of thousands?
questions.why: They are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which 1820 treaty first tied Bahrain to Britain?
questions.why: It was signed with several Gulf rulers.

questions.q: Which ruler led Bahrain to independence?
questions.why: He ruled from 1961 to 1999.

questions.q: Which country gave up its claim to Bahrain after a 1970 UN survey?
questions.why: Bahrainis chose independence.

questions.q: Which 'Tree of Life' has survived alone in the desert for about 400 years?
questions.a: A mesquite tree in the Bahrain desert
questions.why: No one is sure where its water comes from.

questions.q: Which oil company, founded in 1929, was Bahrain's first?
questions.why: It built the Gulf's first refinery.

questions.q: Which British adviser ran much of Bahrain's government from 1926 to 1957?
questions.why: He set up schools and police.

questions.q: What is the capital of Bahrain?
questions.why: It is on the north coast.

questions.q: What is Bahrain's currency?
questions.why: It is one of the world's most valuable currencies.

questions.q: How many islands make up Bahrain, roughly?
questions.why: The main island is Bahrain Island.

questions.q: Which bridge links Bahrain to Saudi Arabia?
questions.why: It opened in 1986.

questions.q: Which Formula One race is held in Bahrain?
questions.why: It was the first F1 race in the Middle East, in 2004.

questions.q: Which sea surrounds Bahrain?
questions.why: It sits between Qatar and Saudi Arabia.

questions.q: Which spiced rice dish is Bahrain's national dish?
questions.why: It is often made with fish or chicken.

questions.q: Which twin towers with wind turbines are a Manama landmark?
questions.why: It was the first skyscraper with built-in wind turbines.

questions.q: Which island town was Bahrain's old capital, with pearling houses?
questions.why: It is on the Pearling Path.

questions.q: Which national museum opened in Manama in 1988?
questions.why: It holds Dilmun treasures.

questions.q: Which island group belongs to Bahrain near Qatar?
questions.why: The ICJ confirmed it in 2001.

questions.q: Which mosque in Manama is one of the world's largest?
questions.why: It can hold about 7,000 worshippers.

questions.q: Which sweet, saffron-scented treat is a Bahraini speciality?
questions.why: Halwa Showaiter is a famous maker.

questions.q: Which flower-filled 'pearl' monument was removed in 2011?
questions.why: It stood at a protest site.

questions.q: Which old gateway in Manama leads into the souq?
questions.why: It was built in 1949.
